set.acceptance: Unit tests in the package that parses the file cover: no file gives plan for every request kind and ship-change for every ready kind; a file setting only [ready] bug changes only that pick; a file holding [request] and [[schedules]] reads with no error; an unknown table, an unknown kind key and a non-string or path-like value each fail with an error naming the table and key
set.statement: Rhiza reads the repo's committed .rhiza/dispatch.toml: a [request] table (a request is queued) and a [ready] table (a change set is accepted and ready), each mapping a kind (feature, bug, milestone) to a workflow name, beside the [[schedules]] entries schedules-file defines; a missing file, table or key falls back to the built-in default (request: plan; ready: ship-change), and any table other than [request], [ready] and [[schedules]], any other key in [request] or [ready], or a value that is not a bare workflow name, is an error naming it
